name: Trequartista 4-3-1-2

slots.why: Distributes short to the midfield triangle or long to the strikers.
Support full-back is the only wide player on the left, so he provides width and crosses.
Central defender. Cover is the alternate.
Central defender on the right. Cover is the alternate, but only one Cover can be used.
Support full-back on the right, the only width on that side.
Ball-winning midfielder wins the ball back in the middle and covers for the trequartista's lack of defensive work.
Defensive central midfielder holds the base of the midfield triangle and protects the defence.
Box-to-box midfielder supports the attack and joins the press.
Trequartista roams freely behind the strikers, finding space to create; he does not press or track back.
Pressing forward (Support) presses the defenders and links with the trequartista, doing the work he does not.
Advanced Forward runs in behind the defence, using the space the trequartista's movement creates. Poacher is the alternate.

style: One free creator, everyone else works
description: A narrow 4-3-1-2 with one trequartista who roams freely behind two strikers, and a hard-working midfield three plus a pressing forward to cover for him.
whyGood: The trequartista creates chances from wherever he finds space, and because the pressing forward and the midfield three do his defensive work, his freedom does not leave the team exposed.
whyThisShape: The trequartista has no fixed position and no defensive duties: he drifts to wherever he can find the ball and create. To make that affordable, the rest of the shape does the work he does not: three central midfielders, one of them a ball-winner, protect the middle, and the pressing forward harries defenders so the team still presses with ten. The full-backs give the only width.
whenToUse: When you have one player of clearly superior creativity who is not suited to a fixed role, and a striker partner who will run and press for him.
whenNotToUse: Against teams that man-mark the playmaker or overload the flanks, since the full-backs are your only wide players; and when the midfield three lacks the energy to cover for him.

instructionRationale.Fairly Narrow: Keeps the team compact around the trequartista and lets him combine with the strikers and midfield.
instructionRationale.Shorter Passing: Keeps the ball in short passes, which is how the trequartista and the midfield link up.
instructionRationale.Work Ball Into Box: Patient movement of the ball until the trequartista finds the pass that opens the defence.
instructionRationale.Counter-Press: Presses at once after losing the ball, led by the pressing forward and ball-winner, since the trequartista will not.
instructionRationale.Standard Line of Engagement: A balanced press keeps the midfield three compact.
instructionRationale.Standard Defensive Line: A balanced line keeps the block compact.

keyRequirements: An exceptional creative player with vision and technique
A pressing forward with high work rate
Full-backs who provide all the width
